mentions.name: Low-level programming learning quest
mentions.description: A personal learning quest to go more low level, studying assembly, C, and WASM, with plans to explore GPU instructions and PTX. The author consciously implements code personally to make the learning stick, occasionally consulting Gemini 3 for pointers when something isn't understood.
mentions.problem: Piling more and more abstractions on top with AI is motivating a return to lower levels of computing.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been on a really fulfilling quest fueled by curiosity to go more low level. I've been doing a lot of assembly, C, WASM and plan to top it off with a look at GPU instructions and PTX.
